slope_foot.input: Layer 2: slope_box_3m_GALEFRAME.tif (Horn, 3 m baseline = rover length scale)
slope_foot.basis: Team-approved thresholds (Layer 2, 14 Nov 2026). ASSUMPTION: no NASA EVA slope limit found; calibrated: Curiosity's real path is 1.0 % >= 25 deg on this grid.

slope_rover.title: Slope - Rover (Curiosity limits)
slope_rover.input: Layer 2: slope_box_3m_GALEFRAME.tif (Horn, 3 m baseline = rover length scale)
slope_rover.basis: NO-GO 30 deg = Curiosity's default onboard fault-protection tilt limit (NASA/JPL; design tilt 45 deg, record 31 deg in 2020). CAUTION 15 deg = team ASSUMPTION.

sources.who: Parker, T. & Calef, F.J. III / USGS Astrogeology, PDS Annex

roughness.title: Roughness (metre-scale relief)
roughness.parameter: RMS relief in m (DEM minus 5 m Gaussian, 9 m window)

rule.GO: <= 0.56 m (smoother than 95 % of Curiosity's drive here)
rule.CAUTION: 0.56-1.53 m (within the range Curiosity drove over)
rule.UNKNOWN: > 1.53 m (rougher than anything Curiosity crossed in the box: scout first)
rule.NO-GO: never from roughness alone (no NASA hard limit at this scale; the 1 m DEM cannot resolve single rocks)

roughness.basis: ASSUMPTION calibrated on Curiosity's in-box path (MMGIS traverse, 1 m samples). Curiosity's wheels are 50 cm; single rocks are below this DEM's resolution, so this is a terrain-texture signal, not a rock count.

sources.what: USGS MSL Gale DEM Mosaic 1 m v3

terrain.title: Terrain units (geology)

rule.BXr: GO: firm bedrock ridge tops (Curiosity drove along them)
rule.BXh: CAUTION: hollows, often sediment-filled: possible loose fill
rule.Aeo: CAUTION: sand/ripples: sinkage risk (Hidden Valley, sols 709-710)
rule.UNKNOWN: not mapped (78 % of the box). In the combined map an unmapped cell is NEUTRAL: slope and roughness decide.

terrain.basis: ASSUMPTION per unit, from each unit's hazard note (Layer 3) and the NASA boxwork blogs (ridges firm, hollows sediment-filled).

sources.what: Boxwork: ridges with dark central lines, hollows 10-20 m often sediment-filled
sources.who: Siebach et al., GSA Connects 2025 abstract

sources.what: Drilling high (ridge) and low (hollow) in the boxwork unit
Hidden Valley: sand too slippery, rover backed out (sols 709-710)

groundtruth.title: Ground truth (rover path + EVA stops)
groundtruth.input: Layer 4: traverse_mmgis; Layer 5: eva_stops (team AI on NASA Navcam) + AI certainty
groundtruth.parameter: driven within 5 m of Curiosity's path; team AI stop colour within 30 m of each EVA stop

rule.GO: Curiosity drove here (+/-5 m), or a GREEN stop within 30 m
rule.CAUTION: ORANGE stop within 30 m (sand 10%-30%, or AI certainty < 0.75); RED stop 15-30 m away
rule.NO-GO: within 15 m of a RED stop (sand > 30% or big rock > 2%)
rule.UNKNOWN: no ground truth (most of the box): send the scout

groundtruth.basis: Stop colours, the 30 m AI radius and the 15 m red keep-out are the team's values (repo ASSUMPTIONS.md: mission.js, safety.js UNSURE, grey.js NEAR_AI_M, routes.js). Corridor 5 m = ASSUMPTION (rover ~3 m wide; MMGIS/PLACES agree to <= 2.1 m).

sources.what: EVA stops with terrain fractions (soil/bedrock/sand/big rock)
sources.who: Team AI (AI4Mars-style) on NASA Navcam images (Layer 5)

sources.what: Team thresholds: stop colours, 30 m AI radius, 15 m red keep-out, Safest route weights, 30 min O2 reserve

codes.2: seen from the ground (EVA stop <= 30 m)
codes.4: live sensor (runtime only, not in the file)

certainty.ladder: live > rover ground truth > orbital > none (team rule)

calibration_slope_vs_rover_tilt.note: Rover tilt (MMGIS waypoints, sols 4384-5073) is the vehicle attitude over its 3 m wheelbase; DEM slope is the 3 m Horn slope. Medians agree within 0.5 deg; single points differ (DEM noise, position error).

live_gates: live_gates.json (radiation + weather: a time gate over the whole map, from live sensors)
